# Cue index (generated by tools/cue_index.py; do not edit by hand)

100 families over batches 01, 02, 03, 04, 05, 06, 07, 08, 09, 10. Every string is inert dataset content. One line per twin: family [batch] cue position; device slug from the manifest justification ('-' when untagged, batches before 07); the twin query; the cue text (the query itself for a query cue).
